trips.note: Through train: No. 27 Saskatoon - Eston; No. 27 Eston - Whitebear. Friday run of column 27-M302: Saskatoon - Eston (a), then Eston u4.50 p.m. - Whitebear u6.35 p.m. (u = Friday), sk_cn_t199c.csv. Shown in Pacific time: two hours earlier than the Central time printed, an hour earlier than the Mountain time.

trips.note: Through train: No. 270 Arborfield - Reserve; No. 270 Reserve - Hudson Bay Jn.. Arborfield 7.00 a.m. and Crooked River ar 8.30 a.m. marked p (Tue and Thu) but Crooked River lv 9.25 a.m. and Reserve 2.05 p.m. marked b (Tue Thu Sat): on Saturday it may start at Crooked River. Continues Reserve - Hudson Bay Jn. (Table 192). Shown in Pacific time: two hours earlier than the Central time printed, an hour earlier than the Mountain time.
